description.zh-CN: OpenJDK 的免费发行版，可自由分发（本项目不使用 Oracle JDK）。
description.en-US: A freely redistributable OpenJDK build (this project does not use Oracle JDK).

notes.zh-CN: 刻意不用 java -version 判定：装了 Oracle JDK 或其它发行版也会命中，会把它们误报成 Temurin。版本信息 M2 补齐。
notes.en-US: Deliberately does not use java -version: that would also match Oracle JDK or other distributions and misreport them as Temurin. Version info to be filled in M2.
